result:
On the merged tree, with the full load dataset and the per-class rate limits raised, 50 simultaneous export starts now stay under 2 s: **0 of 150 over 2 s across three repetitions**. Before BE-Y5's change, QA measured 38 of 50 over. Every clause of REQ-S20-030's acceptance text held on this host. These are provisional figures from one shared 4-vCPU sandbox host, not Mobily capacity and not proof of high-availability readiness. All changes are left uncommitted.

The DG5 historical validation passed (exit 0). Work ran from 01:00:00Z to 01:51:34Z.

### 1. Re-measurement (D-207, F-DG6-147)
Setup: the shipped generator (sha256 `6b2a9007…`, now the same file every earlier DG6 figure used), profile `default`, and `export-proof.mjs` unchanged. Part B formed all 50 user–transformation pairs, so BE-Y4's burst driver wasn't needed for it. Each repetition used a fresh database.

| Rep | Load avg during proof | Part B start p50 / p95 / max | Over 2 s | Time until every job `succeeded` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.87–1.73 | 718 / 908 / 909 ms | 0/50 | 38.8 s |
| 2 | 1.51–2.22 | 651 / 869 / 874 ms | 0/50 | 37.3 s |
| 3 | 3.27–4.80 | 1035 / 1313 / 1330 ms | 0/50 | 39.4 s |

- **Every repetition:** 66 of 66 starts got 202 with a job id, progress reached 100, and the job succeeded.
- **Download check:** the requester got 200 on 66 of 66. Another user with the same scope got 404 on 65 of 65, and the auditor-role (AUD) user got 404 on 66 of 66. No error log lines and no rate-limit refusals.
- **Non-zero exit:** `export-proof` exited 1 in every repetition. The only failing assertion is the known dataset gap: transformation LOAD-T20 has no second user to run the same-scope check against. No latency or access assertion failed.
- **Extra check under load:** 450 more starts while `pnpm test` ran (load average 5–7): 0 over 2 s, max 956 ms. This run also checked the new ADR-0058 rule that a job gets its snapshot before it leaves `queued`: 150 of 150 held in the final run. Two earlier runs flagged 5 jobs each. Run 2's detail shows those were my script misreading HTTP 429 replies from the general per-session limit (300 per minute), triggered by my own 100 ms polling. Run 1 recorded no detail, so its 5 flags are presumably the same artefact but not proven.

### 2. Load drivers
- **`deploy/load/rate-limits.mjs`** (new): running `eval "$(node deploy/load/rate-limits.mjs)"` before starting the API raises the five P6 class limits to 100000 per minute. A value the operator has already set is kept.
- **`deploy/compose/compose.load.yaml`** (new): a Compose overlay that does the same for a load stack.
- **New unit test:** 5 tests tie both files to the API's own list of class variables, so a class added later fails the test until it is raised too.
- **Unchanged:** the general and sign-in limits stay at their product defaults, as in every earlier load run. `deploy/load/README.md` documents all of this.

### 3. Doc drift
`docs/operations/configuration.md` now says the Security page exists. It lists the operations wired to the search, assistant and webhook limits, with their file paths. No English or Arabic UI string said these were planned, so no UI text changed.

### Checks
All exit 0:
- `pnpm -r typecheck`
- `pnpm -r build`
- `pnpm lint`
- the prettier check
- `pnpm openapi:lint`
- `pnpm test`, with the locale unset and with `C.UTF-8`. Both gave the same counts: 2851, 2020 and 259 passed (2 skipped).

The full integration suite was not run, as the assignment allows. No migration, no new dependency, no contract change, and no operations were routed.

### What remains
- **Snapshot assertions:** `export-proof.mjs` (backend-owned) doesn't check the new snapshot rules from ADR-0058. Only my evidence script checked them.
- **LOAD-T20 gap:** it still makes `export-proof` exit 1 on every run; that's the dataset owner's call.
- **Start-up refusal:** the API and worker still don't refuse `MTH_ENV=load` on a database without the load marker. Until they do, nothing stops someone from applying the load overlay to a production database. Keep it to a separate `-p mth-load` project.
- **Finding closure:** F-DG6-147 can only be closed by a reviewer who didn't write the fix.

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/`:
- `T-DG6-DO-Y2-devops-engineer.md`
- `T-DG6-DO-Y2-evidence/` (logs 00–11, the drivers, and the three report JSONs)
